meta.source: Copied from Trianglz/data/screen-templates.json (2026-09-30) and adapted to ClinicSoft component names and clinic content.
meta.rule: Screens are assembled only from components in component-registry.json and tokens in tokens.json. "(to build)" means the component is missing: build it first, lower tiers first.
meta.dark_mode: ClinicSoft is Dark only: every frame uses the Semantic mode Dark. There is no Light frame to duplicate.
meta.screens_file: Screens are built in the Design file "NEW PROJECT Design File" using the DS library; never in the DS file.
meta.app_shell: Signed-in pages: Sidebar (264, left) + Top Bar (64, top) + content on color/bg/primary. Mobile: no Sidebar; Top Bar with an Icon Button (Icon/Menu) that opens it.

sign_in.status: Login / Desktop (1440x900) and Login / Mobile (375x812) built 2026-09-30 in the Design file, approved 2026-09-30
sign_in.use: Staff sign in with email and password.
sign_in.layout: Desktop: two columns, Brand Panel 560 wide (bg/secondary, logo, headline 4xl, supporting text, footer) + Form Panel with the form centered, max width 400. Mobile: single column, 16 margins (space/4 in Mobile mode), logo on top. Sizes follow Intake 7d (1440 / 375).

sections.name: Header
sections.content: logo (Icon/Heart Pulse + ClinicSoft lg/Bold), title Welcome back (3xl/Semi Bold desktop, 2xl mobile), subtitle (base/Regular, text/secondary)

sections.name: Form
components: Input / Text (Work email, Show Leading Icon + Icon/Mail)
Input / Password (Leading Icon Icon/Lock; eye Icon Button shows/hides)

sections.name: Actions
components: Button Type=Filled Size=lg (Sign in, full width)
Button Type=Outline Size=lg (Sign in with a phone code, Leading Icon Icon/Phone)

sections.name: Footer
components: Button Type=Link Size=sm (Ask your clinic admin for an invite)

states: server error (Alert Status=Error above the form)
not_drawn_yet: server error (Alert Status=Error above the form)

sections.name: Form
components: Input / Password (Password + Hint with the rules)

sections.name: Actions
components: Button Type=Filled Size=base (Create account, State=Disabled until valid)

otp_verification.use: Verify a code sent by SMS or email (patient login, prescription pickup).

sections.name: Header
components: Button Type=Link with Leading Icon Icon/Arrow Left (Back)

sections.name: Code
components: OTP / Field (6 cells, auto-advance, paste support)

sections.name: Actions
components: Button Type=Link (Resend code, State=Disabled with countdown)

list.use: Browse a collection (patients, appointments, invoices, lab results).

sections.name: Shell
components: Top Bar (Page Title, Search, primary action e.g. New appointment)

sections.name: Filters
components: Tabs / Bar Type=Segmented or Underline (Today / Upcoming / Past)

sections.name: Items
components: Table or List item (Organism/Molecule, to build) x N with Avatar, name, Badge status, row Icon Button (Icon/More Horizontal) opening Menu
sections.rules: pagination under tables; row actions in a Menu; destructive row action opens Modal Type=Danger

detail.use: One record with its info and actions (patient, appointment, invoice).

sections.name: Sections
components: Tabs / Bar Type=Underline (Overview / Visits / Prescriptions / Files)

form.use: Create or edit a record (book an appointment, add a patient).

sections.name: Fields
components: Radio group (Visit type: In person / Video)
sections.rules: one column on mobile; labels above fields; hint between label and field; error below field; group related fields with section headers

states: validation errors (Alert Status=Error summary + inline Error Message)

sections.name: Groups
components: List item (Molecule, to build) with trailing Toggle / chevron / value
sections.rules: section headers; destructive row (Log Out, Delete account) last, danger color, opens Modal Type=Danger

empty_state.use: No data yet, first run, or no results.

sections.name: Body
components: Icon (Icon/* at 24 inside a bg/subtle circle, or an illustration)
Button Type=Filled Size=base (primary next step, for example New appointment)
